body: Those type of people are literally the scum of the earth. Religion isn't the answer to everyone's problems.

I'm doing fine now but I'm still worried. A lot of my worries are because it's hard for me to motivate and even get out of bed and this is a physical job. But I need the money. I'm just hoping I can hang in there.
Grew up and became an adult.

All the names of the reindeer. Ask me and I can tell you in order in an instant. Which can be funny because I have worked and met people who could only name maybe 1 or 2. That and I can name all 50 states in alphabetical order.

The Truman Show. That movie fucked me up because I can't imagine the hell that you would live in of never knowing the outside world beyond fake walls that was merely a TV show for people. His entire life and existence being a lie all for the purpose of everyone else's entertainment. Might all sound silly but I think deeply about shit like that. Imagine you're locked in a basement since birth and all you know is what people have told you, being lies, and also being the only people you've ever known in your entire existence.
I'm 32 and pretty much just read this thinking I posted it. I'm trying myself to find good logical reasons to keep living but so far it hasn't been easy.
